devtinder.title: DevTinder
devtinder.description: A swipe-based developer networking platform that connects developers with similar tech stacks and helps them collaborate on amazing projects.
devtinder.overview: DevTinder is a full-stack web application built to help developers find the right people to collaborate with. Users can create profiles, swipe through developers, match, chat, and build meaningful connections.

features.title: Secure & Fast
features.description: JWT authentication, REST APIs & optimized performance.

features.title: Deployed on AWS
features.description: Hosted on AWS EC2 with Nginx & SSL.

devtinder.about: DevTinder was built to solve the problem of finding the right co-founders and collaborators. Developers can filter by tech stack, experience and interests to find the perfect match. It includes secure authentication, real-time chat, profile management, and a beautiful swipe-based discovery system.
highlights: Deployed on AWS EC2 with Nginx & SSL
Clean, modular and scalable code architecture

clickcart.title: ClickCart
clickcart.description: A comprehensive e-commerce platform featuring cart, secure checkout, order history, and a role-based admin dashboard.
clickcart.overview: ClickCart is a full-stack e-commerce solution built from scratch to support product listings, cart workflows, checkout processes, and comprehensive order history. It includes a fully-featured Admin Panel with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to securely manage the store.

features.title: Cart & Checkout
features.description: Reduced purchase flow to under 3 steps.

features.title: Admin Panel
features.description: Full CRUD operations, pagination, and search for products.

clickcart.about: Built to streamline the shopping experience and provide powerful tools for store administrators. Supported 100+ products and 50+ admin listings, significantly reducing manual order processing time.
challenges: Securing admin endpoints with JWT RBAC
Implementing complex SQL queries for order history
highlights: Built Admin Panel with CRUD, pagination, and search for 50+ listings
Integrated JWT RBAC securing 100% of API endpoints

food-ordering-web-app.title: Food Ordering Web App
food-ordering-web-app.description: A highly optimized food ordering interface featuring restaurant listings, Shimmer UI, and advanced filtering.
food-ordering-web-app.overview: A frontend-focused food ordering application built to provide a blazing-fast user experience. It leverages Redux Toolkit for state management and features a fully fleshed-out search and cart system.

features.title: Fast Search & Filter
features.description: Reduced search-to-order flow to under 4 clicks.

features.title: Shimmer UI
features.description: Smooth loading states for better perceived performance.

food-ordering-web-app.about: Developed to solve slow load times and janky UI interactions. Features 100+ restaurant listings and utilizes Parcel for 30% faster builds. The focus was on establishing a bug-free critical path and exceptional performance.
challenges: Optimizing search and filtering across 100+ listings
Managing complex state with Redux Toolkit
Writing comprehensive tests to reach 90% coverage
highlights: Featured 100+ restaurant listings with Shimmer UI
Reduced search-to-order flow to under 4 clicks
